title: Graduating from your Dark Green Account
summary: Explains how to transition from a Dark Green Account to a regular checking account after graduation, including eligibility (request at graduation with degree-completion proof; if age 26, transition happens) and claiming a one-time $100.00 bonus. The $100.00 is credited after proof is verified and the transition steps are completed, and the new account’s features/fees apply after completion.
faqs: How do I request a transition from my Dark Green Account after graduation?
What proof do I need to provide to graduate and qualify for the transition?
